title: The marks that say a document carries a LIVE obligation -- each with the calibration that proves it reads what it claims (ADR-019 decision 5)
description: An obligation is a promise the system has made and not yet kept; a marker is how a machine can tell that a document carries one. This is the vocabulary of those marks, and it is DATA: a new mark is a row, and no interpreter holds a pattern of its own. ONE SHAPE, TWO SIDES -- the kit ships its default set as a governance document, and a host that needs its own marks declares another instance of this same schema in its corpus; the effective vocabulary is the union, and neither side edits the other's file. CALIBRATED BY CONSTRUCTION: every row carries one text it MUST match and one lookalike it MUST tolerate, exactly as the residence vocabulary calibrates every genre it refuses. This is not decoration. A marker vocabulary with no calibration is a regex somebody believed, and the first time it is wrong it is wrong silently, in the direction of reporting that nothing is owed.

id.description: The id of this SET of marks -- the kit's default set, or a host's own. It names the instance, never the marks in it.

pattern.description: The expression, applied to one line of a document's text, whose match means: an obligation is open here. It is matched against text and never against a path -- what a document is called is not what it owes.

because.description: Why a match of this mark is a LIVE obligation rather than a turn of phrase. Stated in the row so the reason travels with the pattern and a later reader can judge the pattern against it.

proves.description: CALIBRATION, positive: one line this pattern MUST match. A row whose `proves` does not match is a broken detector, and it is caught by the vocabulary's own test rather than by a corpus that quietly reports nothing owed.

admits.description: CALIBRATION, negative: one realistic lookalike this pattern MUST tolerate -- prose that mentions the mark, or a closed form of it. The false positive is the expensive failure here: it routes work that does not exist, and a gate that cries wolf is switched off within a week.
